s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, painless breast enlargement with a well-defined mass
salient_findings: Painless enlargement of the left breast
Well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins
Homogeneously hyperechoic mass on ultrasonography
Heterogeneous lucent mass on mammography
T1- and T2-hyperintense mass on magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Dilated surface veins on the left breast
Normal overlying skin, nipple, and areola
Ultrasonography shows a homogeneously hyperechoic mass
Mammography reveals a heterogeneous lucent mass
Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrates a well-defined, homogeneous mass

shortlist.label: Breast lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical and imaging findings of a well-defined, homogeneous mass with no cystic areas or internal vascularity

shortlist.label: Hamartoma of the breast
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with a progressive, painless breast enlargement and a well-defined mass on imaging

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the large size of the mass and the presence of dilated surface veins

shortlist.label: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Could explain the progressive breast enlargement and the imaging findings of a well-defined mass

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely given the large size, it remains a possible diagnosis for a well-defined, homogeneous mass

raw.rationale: The clinical and imaging findings, including a well-defined, homogeneous mass with benign calcifications and no internal vascularity, are consistent with a hamartoma, which is a benign breast tumor composed of a mixture of glandular, fibrous, and adipose tissue.

rejected.label: Breast lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically composed of pure adipose tissue and do not usually contain benign calcifications or a heterogeneous lucent mass on mammography.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large and rapidly growing, but they often have a more heterogeneous appearance on imaging and may exhibit internal vascularity or cystic areas, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia
rejected.why: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia typically presents as a diffuse or nodular area of stromal proliferation, rather than a well-defined mass, and often has a more complex appearance on imaging.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Fibroadenomas are usually smaller and more mobile than the mass described in this case, and they often have a more characteristic appearance on ultrasonography and mammography, with a hypoechoic or isodense mass and a distinct border.
